facts.fact: Angola says changes to the civil registry and identity card laws led to operations to merge the two systems, and a multifunctional database under the Ministry of Justice holds the civil registry and identity card management systems.

systems.system: Bilhete de Identidade / Numero Unico do Cidadao (NUC)
systems.owner: Ministerio da Justica e dos Direitos Humanos

AGO.note: No count or share of people enrolled is given.

facts.fact: Angola says its civil registration process includes assigning the Numero Unico do Cidadao (NUC), described as the structuring element enabling the identity card, from the first weeks of life; the document describes this as part of a phased target architecture.
Angola says the government implemented a multifunctional database under management of the Ministry of Justice as the centre of the digital identity.

Angola's target architecture lists integration of the criminal record, vehicle registration, commercial registry, land registry and notarial systems with the civil registry and identity card system in the digital identity database; the document does not say they are keyed on the NUC.

Angola presents a phased Bilhete de Identidade Digital, with an authentication capability, a digital identity wallet app and fingerprint, face, iris and biometric signature enrolment at birth registration and ID issue, as its target architecture.
